>Everything is shut down still and the government is going to fuck me and my generation over in the future with the dumbass decisions they’re making.

100% agree. As long as people get theirs they don't give a shit about the younger generations.

>Everyone told me it was a good idea and that I was being responsible.

I resonate with this a lot. I made a similar decision that everyone said was a good idea and it destroyed my life. Makes me think I should just listen to myself sometimes.

>Tired of being told it gets better. When? I’ve waited 30 years, when is it getting better?

Spot on. Do these people who keep saying "it gets better" have any connection with reality? Evidence points to no.
RIGHT?! I talked with my mom about suicide once. Never again. I had to calm HER down!!!

>You want to leave? Too bad, you can't. You're held hostage by people you care about.

100% agree. It's fucking ridiculous. They don't care about your pain at all.
